tooltip.jaymospowers.unbonded: Not bonded: rest with it on you to bond. It does nothing until then.
tooltip.jaymospowers.unknown: Its powers are not known yet. Use it a while, or have a wizard or a sage look at it.
tooltip.jaymospowers.curse.clinging: Cursed: you cannot put it down.
tooltip.jaymospowers.curse.thirst: Cursed: it drinks your blood with each kill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.curse.whispers: Cursed: it whispers you toward your friends.
screen.jaymospowers.bonds.title: Bonds
screen.jaymospowers.bonds.hint: Click a bond to let it go.
tooltip.jaymospowers.artifact.boots_of_l: A longer stride, and a step up a block and a half without a jump.
tooltip.jaymospowers.artifact.cloak_of_t: More breath, and while it is on you breathe under water.
